answer: An identity registers only by binding one non-transferable credential to a 400 POA bond locked for 80 epochs, and the bond funds the agent's whole voyage, so credential and money are one unit. A grove of independent auditor nodes holds the public registry and runs a falcon-fast sweep each epoch, verifying any credential against all others in seconds. The enforcement leg is split-slash: if one credential appears under two identities, both bonds burn 100% and the credential is void, so each fake costs 400 POA locked 80 epochs; 1,000 fakes cost 400,000 POA, locked and unrecoverable.
